title: Not Leakproof at All!
text: Not Leakproof at All!. I bought this set because of the great reviews and that it is advertised as "LEAKPROOF" - this is a lie.  I just made some jello and put it in the fridge and noticed orange dots on my linoleum and took it out.  I tipped it over the sink and it just dripped everywhere.  It seems fine for no liquid use, but Lock n Lock is still the standard for leakproof.  This was a poor purchase and I won't order again!  BTW - I hand wash these - never dishwasher.
